packages/learning/src/challenger.ts:25-84 recomputes four distinct persisted receipt/artifact observations into two comparable fail-to-pass episodes. packages/contracts/src/sql-mission-store.ts:82-119 binds a promoted lesson's ID/version/challenge/recovery-policy digest into a later comparable snapshot and action, then rechecks current promotion before judgment commit.
